_status: PROPOSED — not applied. Do not import into the live zone without owner approval. Values marked <...> come from Vercel / Cloudflare dashboards at setup time.

records.name: gobye.app
records.content: <Vercel apex A record shown in Vercel → Domains>
records.purpose: Public website on Vercel. DNS only (grey cloud) so Vercel's CDN, TLS and firewall stay in charge.

records.name: www.gobye.app
records.purpose: Website alias, redirected to the apex by Vercel.

records.name: admin.gobye.app
records.purpose: Management web app on Vercel. DNS only. Access also protected by staff sign-in + MFA (and optionally Cloudflare Access in front, which would require proxying — decide separately).

records.name: api.gobye.app
records.purpose: Public API entry. Proxied so the gateway Worker, WAF and rate-limiting rules run. Origins are never published in DNS.

records.name: api-staging.gobye.app
records.purpose: Staging API, separate secrets and origins.

records.name: realtime.gobye.app
records.purpose: WebSocket / realtime service if it is separated from the API. Proxied (Cloudflare supports WebSockets on proxied hostnames).

records.name: media.gobye.app
records.purpose: Approved PUBLIC media only. Private buckets never get a custom domain or r2.dev access.

records.name: uploads.gobye.app
records.purpose: Optional controlled upload service. Presigned uploads go to the R2 S3 endpoint, not this hostname.

records.name: driver.gobye.app
records.purpose: Future driver web portal (likely Vercel, DNS only).

keep: Any existing MX / TXT (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and Vercel verification TXT records must be preserved exactly.
CAA records, if added, must allow the certificate authorities Vercel and Cloudflare use.
